hooks.command: input=$(cat); cmd=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.command'); if printf '%s\n' "$cmd" | grep -qE '(^|[;&|[:space:]])(bundle exec rspec|bin/rubocop|bundle exec rubocop|bin/brakeman|bundle exec brakeman)' && ! printf '%s\n' "$cmd" | grep -q 'LANG='; then new_cmd="export LANG=en_US.UTF-8 LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8; $cmd"; jq -n --arg cmd "$new_cmd" '{hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "PreToolUse", permissionDecision: "allow", updatedInput: {command: $cmd}}}'; fi
